en.headline: Ng Ka-ki takes Asian Games bronze on men's vault
en.dek: The gymnast scored 14.116 across two vaults in Nagoya, giving Hong Kong its first gymnastics medal of these Games and lifting the city tally to 25.
body: Ng Ka-ki won bronze in the men's vault at the Asian Games on Friday, Hong Kong's first gymnastics medal of the Aichi-Nagoya Games.

In an eight-man final at Nagoya City General Gymnasium, Ng scored 14.233 on his first vault and 14.000 on his second, averaging 14.116. Carlos Yulo of the Philippines took gold with 14.599 and Mahdi Olfati of Iran silver with 14.533.

The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, congratulated Ng, who is competing at his second Asian Games, saying he had overcome a recurring injury to produce a strong vault performance. She also congratulated the men's foil team that later took silver against Japan.
The two Friday medals took the Hong Kong, China delegation to 25 medals at the Games: four gold, 11 silver and 10 bronze.

zh.headline: 吳家祺亞運男子跳馬摘銅 港隊體操開齋
zh.dek: 吳家祺兩跳平均14.116分，為港隊本屆亞運首面體操獎牌，港隊累積獎牌增至25面。
body: 港隊體操選手吳家祺周五在亞運男子跳馬決賽奪銅，成為香港在愛知縣－名古屋亞運的首面體操獎牌。
八人決賽在名古屋市綜合體育館舉行，吳家祺第一跳得14.233分，第二跳14.000分，平均14.116分。金牌由菲律賓選手尤洛以14.599分奪得，銀牌是伊朗選手奧爾法蒂的14.533分。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩祝賀吳家祺，指他第二次出戰亞運，克服舊患後在跳馬交出高水平表現。她同日亦祝賀稍後在男子團體花劍決賽摘銀的港隊劍擊隊。
連同花劍銀牌，港隊周五再添兩面獎牌，亞運累積成績為4金、11銀、10銅，合共25面獎牌。
